instruction.task: Implement Phase 1, Slice 4 of the Agency Command Center ERP.
instruction.objective: Add blocker logging and resolution so task execution can represent real operational impediments without hidden status changes.

section.title: 1. Blocker Creation
section.requirement: Implement POST /api/blockers with task_id, title, description, severity, and impact.
Validate the task belongs to a workflow/client inside the authenticated tenant.
Creating a blocker must set the linked task status to blocked in the same transaction.
Write activity logs for blocker creation and task status change.

section.title: 2. Blocker List and Detail
section.requirement: Implement GET /api/blockers with filters for status, severity, client, and task.
Implement GET /api/blockers/:id returning linked client, linked task, impact, status, and resolution fields.
Build blocker list screen with open/resolved filters and severity styling.
Build blocker detail screen showing impact and resolution tracking.

section.title: 3. Blocker Resolution
section.requirement: On resolution, restore task to in_progress only if no open blockers remain for that task.
Set resolved_at, resolved_by, and write activity logs for blocker and task updates.

logic.description: Blocker creation and resolution must be transactional with task status updates.
Team Members may create blockers only on assigned tasks. PM/Admin may create and resolve blockers.
Resolving one blocker must not unblock a task if another open blocker remains.

item.req: Blocked status transition and restore logic

instruction.first_principles_check: A blocker is not a note. It is a stateful operational entity that blocks a task, affects dashboard risk, and requires explicit resolution.
